pipeline.description: Two-stage build: consolidator merges all build.json + config.json sources into the master file; derive emits per-container + archived split files from the master.
source_inputs: vault/secrets.yaml (sops-encrypted secrets per service, key names extracted)

outputs.per_container: 2_configs/dist/build-{container_or_service_name}.json (one per container, plus one per container-less service — derive output)
outputs.archived: 2_configs/dist/z_archive/cloud-data-{slice}.json (deprecated split files — kept for soft-transition fallbacks; consumers should read consolidated instead)

services.name: caddy-l4-public
services.description: Public-edge Caddy-L4 SNI mux on oci-analytics. Owns the public 0.0.0.0:443. SNI allowlist *.diegonmarcos.com → TCP-relay to gcp-proxy via wg-public (10.1.0.2:443; oci-analytics is the hub at 10.1.0.1, gcp-proxy is the spoke at 10.1.0.2). Unmatched SNI gets TCP RST. Pure layer-4 — does NOT terminate TLS; the gcp-proxy Caddy edge still handles all cert + routing logic. This makes oci-analytics THE single public-edge VM per the wg-public hardening design (operator policy 2026-05-23): gcp-proxy stays fully private, c3-public-api remains the only application surface directly served from oci-analytics; everything else either flows through this L4 relay to gcp-proxy or peers join wg-public to reach 10.1.0.2:443 directly.

services.name: cf-worker-http-to-wg-public-bridge
services.description: HTTP-to-SMTP bridge on oci-analytics (the public-ingress VM in the wg-public mesh). CF Worker POSTs JSON email payloads to this container; container speaks SMTP over wg-public to maddy:25 + stalwart:2025 on oci-mail. Public path: api.diegonmarcos.com/cf-worker-bridge/. Mirrors aa-sui_tools-http-to-smtp-proxy-api shape but binds on the wg-public hub IP (10.1.0.1) and forwards over wg-public.

services.name: wireguard-mesh
services.description: Read-only data-driven control panel for the WireGuard mesh + wstunnel TCP/443 fallback. Mimics Headscale's UI shape but holds zero state and exposes zero mutations — pure observability over the existing declarative VPN data (cloud-data-topology.json + bb-net_vpn/build.json + terraform.json). Snapshot is frozen at deploy time; the page hydrates from PORTAL_DATA, no runtime fetch.

services.name: wireguard-mesh-ws-tunnel
services.description: WireGuard-over-TCP/443 fallback for hostile networks (airport / hotel / corporate guest Wi-Fi blocking UDP). Sibling to bb-net_wireguard-mesh (the panel) — this folder owns the wstunnel-server that terminates WSS on gcp-proxy and forwards UDP to the kernel WG listener at 127.0.0.1:51820. UDP/51820 remains the primary transport; this kicks in only when clients can't reach UDP.

services.name: wireguard-public
services.description: Owner of the wg-public mesh topology + client list. Data-only entry (enabled=false → no container/compose). Replaces the previous wireguard_public block that lived in config.json (root global), so adding/rotating/sharing a wg-public client is a one-file edit here instead of touching the global config.
